PATTERN: Maestro visual screenshot loop for keyboard appearance testing.

FILES:
- Maestro/visual-backgrounds.yaml — 7 HTML data: URLs with different bg colors (white, black, red, blue, dark, gradient, pink), captures screenshot after keyboard appears on each
- Maestro/visual-apps.yaml — opens Messages, Spotlight, Safari with colored pages; screenshots keyboard on real app backgrounds

KEY TECHNIQUE:
- Use Safari with data: URLs to inject exact background colors
- After typing in address bar → keyboard appears → screenshot → hideKeyboard → tap address bar again (shows 'data:') → next URL
- Spotlight: launch via accessibilityId then tap search field
- Messages: dismiss 'Apple Intelligence' onboarding first

SIMULATOR DARK MODE: `xcrun simctl ui booted appearance dark` / `light` to toggle between modes

LIMITATION: Maestro can visually screenshot but cannot verify key output (UIControl limitation)

OUTPUT DIRS:
- /tmp/keyboard-screenshots/light/ 
- /tmp/keyboard-screenshots/dark/
